ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Open to all students (grads and undergrads). Lectures are provided online and are videotaped from an on-campus sustainability series and are to be viewed weekly prior to discussion sessions on Tuesdays (for those not living locally and cannot attend them live). These will be posted the day following the live presentations (Thursdays starting Feb. 4th) for asynchronous access. Tuesday discussions require that each student have high speed internet access (not on wireless), and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $309.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $277.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
